situation: Undo by the person who checked in
given: a Staff Member holds front_desk.check_in and not front_desk.check_out
when: they withdraw a mistaken check-in
then: it succeeds: withdrawing is part of checking in

situation: Check-out without check-in
given: a Staff Member holds front_desk.check_out only
when: they check a Guest out, or try to withdraw a check-in
then: the check-out succeeds and the withdrawal is refused

situation: Check-in without check-out
given: a Staff Member holds front_desk.check_in only
when: they try to end a Stay
then: refused

situation: A check-in role at a Property that bills
given: an Organization's own role holds front_desk.check_in and not finance.manage_folio
when: they check a Guest in at a Property with the finance capability
then: the Folio the check-in needs is opened; posting to it still needs finance.post_charge

situation: Cancelling has its own permission
given: front_desk.cancel is in the catalogue and in the shipped owner, manager and front desk roles
when: a Staff Member cancels a booking or records a no-show
then: only a role holding front_desk.cancel can; a check-in role cannot cancel and a cancel role cannot check in

situation: A departed Stay is history
given: a Stay is departed
when: any role, the owner included, moves it to cancelled or back in house
then: refused: the only Stay transitions are reserved to in_house or cancelled, and in_house to departed or cancelled; undoing a check-out is not built

situation: Terminal Reservations
given: a Reservation is cancelled or no_show
when: any role, the owner included, moves it anywhere
then: refused: only the transitions drawn in docs/features/check-out/states.mmd with a command behind them exist

situation: Reopening a Folio
given: a Staff Member holds a front-desk permission and not finance.manage_folio
when: they reopen a closed Folio
then: refused: front-desk roles may close a Folio as part of ending a Stay, and nothing else

situation: A role with no front-desk command
given: a Staff Member holds only front_desk.book
when: they update a Reservation's status
then: nothing changes and nothing is raised, the same answer as a row out of reach

situation: A Guest overstays
given: a Guest is in house past their planned departure
when: another Guest is checked in to the same Unit
then: refused with UnitHasOccupantError: one in-house Stay per Unit whatever the dates say

situation: Same-day turnover
given: a Guest is due out today and has not been checked out
when: tonight is booked in their Unit, and that booking is checked in
then: the booking is accepted; the check-in is refused with UnitHasOccupantError until the departing Guest is checked out, then succeeds

situation: Booking over somebody in house
given: a Guest is in house until a later date
when: a booking is taken over any of their remaining nights
then: refused with UnitHasOccupantError at the booking, not at the desk on the day

situation: Open-ended Resident
given: a Resident is in house with no end date
when: a booking is taken on their Unit for any future night
then: refused: an open-ended Stay holds every night until it ends

situation: Overstay grows into a booking
given: a booking was taken legally and the Guest before it then overstayed into its nights
when: the booking is updated without moving its Unit or dates, for example cancelled
then: allowed: the rule is checked when a row starts holding nights or moves them, never on an unrelated update; moving its nights is refused

situation: Booking and check-in at once
given: a Reservation is being checked in
when: another booking over its nights is taken at the same moment on a second connection
then: exactly one wins; advisory lock namespace 2 on the Unit serialises both sides

situation: Blocked after booking
given: a confirmed Reservation's Unit is blocked or put out of service
when: it is checked in
then: refused with UnitNotInServiceError and nothing is left half-done

situation: A withdrawal and a check-in on one Unit
given: a Guest due out today is in house and tonight's Guest is being checked in
when: somebody withdraws the first check-in at the same moment, on a second connection
then: both complete or the check-in is refused as occupied; never a deadlock (40P01), which was reproduced before the fix

situation: Taking back a check-in whoever holds the Unit
given: a Reservation is checked in and its nights are held by another Stay meanwhile
when: the check-in is withdrawn and the Reservation returns to confirmed
then: allowed: returning from checked in is not a Reservation starting to hold nights

situation: A reference a front desk can read aloud
given: a Reservation is created, by any route
when: it is inserted
then: it is given R and six Crockford base-32 characters from a scrambled sequence, unique across the product; a reference named in the insert is replaced

situation: Cancelling a booking
given: a requested or confirmed Reservation
when: a Staff Member holding front_desk.cancel cancels it with a reason
then: it becomes cancelled, its nights are free to sell again, the reason is the audit record's and reservation.cancelled is published; a reason outside 3 to 2000 characters is refused

situation: Cancelling an arrival
given: the Reservation is checked in
when: somebody cancels it
then: refused: a Guest who arrived is checked out or their check-in withdrawn, never cancelled

situation: No-show before the day
given: a confirmed Reservation whose first night is still ahead
when: somebody marks it a no-show
then: refused: until the first night somebody may still come

situation: No-show on or after the day
given: a confirmed Reservation whose first night has come
when: somebody marks it a no-show
then: it becomes no_show, leaves the arrivals list, frees its nights, and reservation.no_show is published

situation: Ending another Organization's booking
given: a Reservation in another Organization
when: somebody cancels it or marks it a no-show
then: refused with the same answer as one that does not exist

situation: Readiness says why
given: a Reservation on the arrivals list is requested, or its Unit is blocked, out of service, or has somebody in it
when: the list is read
then: canCheckIn is false and checkInBlocker names which; the screen shows the reason where the button would be, and pressing check-in anyway is refused with the matching error

situation: The occupant's lateness
given: the Unit is occupied
when: the list is read
then: occupantLeaves says when the Guest in the room is due to leave — overdue, today, a later day, or never said — so the badge reads overstaying, due out today, or occupied

situation: Controls a viewer cannot use
given: a Staff Member without front_desk.check_in, front_desk.check_out or front_desk.cancel reads a front-desk list
when: the screen renders
then: the check-in, undo, check-out, cancel and no-show controls they cannot use are not offered; the policies still decide

situation: Beds are named by their room
given: a bed A in room 401
when: any front-desk list or the booking form shows it
then: it reads 401 · A and sorts under its room; searching for the room name or the reference finds it on every front-desk list

situation: Departures polls
given: two desks have departures open
when: one checks a Guest out
then: the other's list drops the row within thirty seconds, like arrivals

situation: Taking a booking with an expected time
given: a Staff Member may book
when: they take a booking and give the time the Guest expects to arrive
then: ranza_app holds an insert grant on expected_arrival_time with the eight columns a booking is taken with, and nothing else about the grant changed

situation: Only one way to change it afterwards
given: a booking has an expected time
when: any role other than the amend command tries to change it
then: ranza_app holds no update grant on the column and no other runtime role holds any; app.change_expected_arrival() is executable by ranza_app alone

situation: Reading the time
given: a front-desk reader lists arrivals or reservations
when: the rows are read
then: the time is part of what ranza_app may select, so every list that shows a booking can show it

situation: The time is kept to the minute
given: a desk that may book
when: it takes a booking with 15:30
then: the booking holds 15:30 and the form, the Server Action and the module carry it as HH:MM

situation: No time is a normal booking
given: a desk takes a booking and leaves the time empty
when: the booking is saved
then: the time is null, the booking is as valid as one with a time, and every list says it has none

situation: A role that cannot book cannot set a time
given: a Staff Member holding housekeeping only
when: they insert a booking with a time
then: refused by reservations_insert_front_desk: the time is no way round the policy

situation: A role that books without amending
given: a Staff Member holding front_desk.book and front_desk.check_in but not front_desk.amend
when: they take a booking with a time
then: it is saved: the time is part of taking the booking, and what they may not do is change it afterwards (FD-S6-08)

situation: Changing the time needs front_desk.amend
given: a Staff Member holding front_desk.check_in and front_desk.book but not front_desk.amend
when: they change the time with a statement of their own, or through the command
then: both are refused (42501): the statement for want of an update grant, the command for want of the permission; the module reports it as a booking that cannot be changed

situation: Housekeeping cannot change the time
given: a Staff Member holding housekeeping only
when: they call the command
then: refused (42501), as any caller outside the front desk's gates and permission is

situation: Another Organization's or a desk-less Property's booking
given: a desk in another Organization, or at a Property with no front desk
when: they call the command for the booking
then: refused with the answer a booking that does not exist would get (42501), so nothing is confirmed to a caller who cannot see it

situation: A booking that has arrived or finished keeps its time
given: a booking that is cancelled, checked in, checked out or a no-show
when: the command is called
then: refused (42501); a revision of the time names no Stay, so it only ever belongs to a booking that has not arrived

situation: Changing the time alone moves nothing else
given: a confirmed booking with no time and a desk holding front_desk.amend
when: they set 16:00
then: the booking holds 16:00 and its nights, Unit and price are exactly as they were; no Unit lock is taken because no night moves

situation: A change of time is a revision and an audit record
given: a desk changes the time
when: the command returns
then: one append-only reservation_changes row of kind arrival_time_changed records the time before and after, the business day, the note and who; the audit record reservation.arrival_time_changed says the same (times only, no Guest detail) and is labelled in the audit screen in every language

situation: Two desks change one booking
given: a desk read the booking at version 0 and somebody else has changed it since
when: the first saves a time
then: refused as changed since read (RZ003) and the dialog reads again, as for the nights (AB-S1-19)

situation: Saving the time it already has
given: a booking whose time is 16:00
when: a desk saves 16:00
then: refused as changing nothing (23514); the dialog does not offer Save until something differs

situation: Clearing the time
given: a booking with a time
when: a desk empties the field and saves
then: the time is null, which is a change like any other and leaves a revision; an omitted field in a form that never carried one leaves the time as it is

situation: A revision of the time has a shape
given: any role, the table owner included
when: a revision of kind arrival_time_changed is written with equal times, or another kind carries a time
then: refused by reservation_changes_arrival_time_is_its_own_kind (23514); the rows are never rewritten or deleted

situation: The arrivals row shows the time
given: an arrival with a time and one without
when: the arrivals list is read
then: the first shows its time as the reader's language writes a time of day, 24-hour, never shifted by the reader's zone; the second shows a dash that a screen reader announces as no expected time. The column is sortable and holds the ones with no time last in either direction

situation: The time has passed
given: a confirmed arrival due today whose expected time has passed on the Property's clock
when: the arrivals list is read
then: the row says so in the warning tone; the comparison is the booking's own day plus the time, in the Property's timezone, against the database's clock, never the browser's. A Guest checked in, an unsaid time, and a booking already days late (which says so itself) show no such word

situation: Editing the time from Change booking
given: an arrival with a time of 14:00 and a desk holding front_desk.amend
when: they open Change booking, enter 18:30 and save
then: the field is filled from the booking, Save is off until something differs, and the row follows with 18:30; clearing it shows the dash again

situation: The booking form asks for the time last
given: the New reservation form
when: it is opened and a blocked submit focuses the first problem
then: the field is optional and after the dates; the Guest is still asked about first (RG-S4-19)

situation: Nights and time in one save
given: a desk changes the dates and the time in one dialog
when: they save
then: both land in one transaction as two revisions, the nights first; if the nights are refused (taken, out of service, a price that moved) the time is not changed either

situation: A time that is not a time
given: a request carrying 25:00, 9:30 or text for the time
when: it reaches the module
then: refused before any statement runs as a field the person can fix, with the sentence in every language; nothing is written

situation: The time is on the booking's day
given: a Property whose business date still reads yesterday between midnight and its cutoff
when: an arrival due yesterday's business date has 23:30 and it is now 01:00
then: the time is read on the booking's own calendar day, so 23:30 has passed and the row says so; a time after midnight is entered for the day the booking starts, not the night's far side

situation: A Property's timezone is corrected later
given: bookings carry 15:00 and the Property's timezone is changed
when: the arrivals list is read
then: the clock reading stays 15:00 on the Property's new clock, so the instant it means moves with the zone; nothing converts it. Whether a correction should be offered a conversion is a question for the owner
